verification_candidates.claim_text: A person avoided contracting coronavirus, unlike five family members at the same gathering, and attributes this to her diet.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I'm convinced it's because of the way I eat.
verification_candidates.rationale: Personal causal attribution linking diet to COVID resistance is an anecdote-based claim that needs evidence checking before generalizing.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking broad-spectrum antibiotics for minor illnesses like sniffles and coughs kills off the gut microbiome.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the broad spectrum antibiotics that all of us took for every little sniffle, for every little cough that hurts us, we're killing off our microbiome.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable causal claim about antibiotic overuse harming the gut microbiome.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Most probiotics are destroyed by stomach acid or bile before reaching the gut and are therefore not effective.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most probiotics are pretty worthless because they're not protected from acid in the stomach or bile in the in the first part of the duodenum, which will kill them.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable mechanistic claim about probiotic survival through digestion affecting efficacy.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Spore-forming or encapsulated probiotics resist gastric and bile digestion and are therefore more effective.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: That's either a spore-forming probiotic, or that's encapsulated so it resists gastric and bile digestion.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable mechanistic/product-efficacy claim about spore-forming and encapsulated probiotics.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A probiotic product's bacterial count (such as 100 billion) is irrelevant if it lacks a system for surviving digestion to reach the gut.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it doesn't matter if you see, oh, this has got a hundred billion probiotics. If it doesn't have a system for getting it into your gut, it won't get into your gut.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable claim that probiotic CFU counts are meaningless without a delivery mechanism surviving digestion.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Prebiotics are more important than probiotics because they are the food the probiotic bacteria need to survive.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: What's more important is prebiotics. So that's the food that the probiotics have to eat.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable claim about the relative importance of prebiotics versus probiotics for gut bacteria.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Leaky gut is the cause of a weak immune system.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: how leaky gut is the cause of a weak immune system.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable causal claim linking leaky gut to immune weakness.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Humans are evolutionarily ill-suited to social distancing because social interaction and touch are fundamental to great ape societies.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It is, if you will, it is not in our DNA to social distance.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable claim about the evolutionary/biological basis for humans' need for social interaction, relevant to pandemic-era isolation effects on health.
